propDocs.Pagination.total: Total results, used with pageSize to derive page count.
propDocs.Pagination.pageSize: Number of results on each page.
propDocs.Pagination.siblings: Visible page numbers on either side of the current page.
propDocs.Pagination.boundaries: Visible pages at each end of the range.
propDocs.PaginationPrevious.children: Custom label; omitted content uses the default chevron.
propDocs.PaginationNext.children: Custom label; omitted content uses the default chevron.
